import pandas as pd

sheets = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} ===")
    print(f"Shape: {df.shape}")
    print(f"Columns: {list(df.columns)}")
    print(df.to_string())
    print()

from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=True)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} ===")
    print(f"Dimensions: {ws.dimensions}, max_row={ws.max_row}, max_col={ws.max_column}")
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        vals = [(c.coordinate, c.value) for c in row if c.value is not None]
        if vals:
            print(vals)
    print()
